A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BBP is a mechanoelastic protein, which may be involved in the regulation of protein–protein interaction and/or in the transport of lipophilic substances in the insect.
the characterization of the butterfly BBP provides the first data on the presence of BBP in the brain of a vertebrate.

The main takeaway from our work is that
BBP, a pigment protein in butterfly wings, is a mechanoelastic protein with a role for protein–protein interactions and that the BBP‐like apolipoprotein in mouse is a protein with similar functions.
BBP, as a lipocalin, may have a role in the transport of lipids in the brain.
BBP can be used as a tool to study the role of lipocalins and their PTMs in Lepidoptera.
